id: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \bYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \bSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Be careful out there. The cold can get to you quickly.
en: \bOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Be careful out there. The cold can get to you quickly.
it: \bOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto.  Fai attenzione là fuori. Il freddo può farsi sentire in fretta.
